'''Fire Strike''' is a [[Fire spells|fire]]-based [[Strike spells|strike spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], available at level 13 [[Magic]]. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Fire Strike has a base maximum hit of 8. As with all combat spells, this maximum hit is increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a fire-based spell, Fire Strike's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire]].

== Notable uses ==

* As a strike spell, Fire Strike is one of the only spells that can be used to damage [[Salarin the twisted]]. When used this way, its damage is scaled up to match that of [[Fire Bolt]].

== Trivia ==

* Prior to [[Update:Project Rebalance: Combat Changes#Elemental Spell Scaling|an update on May 29, 2024]], Fire Strike had the highest base maximum hit out of all the strike spells. For this reason, it was commonly used by low-level players to defeat enemies and quest bosses with a much higher combat level, such as the [[Khazard warlord]] in the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest. After the update, all of the strike spells have a base maximum hit equal to the strongest strike spell that the player has unlocked, making [[Wind Strike]] a cheaper but equally effective alternative (unless the player is fighting a monster that is specifically [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire spells]]).
